name: twrses-earth
description: 地球與天氣 Earth and Weather 3D 模型的原始碼與打包設定。產物寫到 assets/js/，npm run build 重新打包。

scripts.build: esbuild src/earth-quake.js src/earth-inside.js src/earth-shake.js src/earth-mountain.js src/earth-volcano.js src/earth-rain.js src/earth-wind.js src/earth-typhoon.js src/earth-lightning.js src/earth-forecast.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
scripts.test: node test/quake.test.mjs && node test/inside.test.mjs && node test/shake.test.mjs && node test/mt.test.mjs && node test/vol.test.mjs && node test/rain.test.mjs && node test/wind.test.mjs && node test/typhoon.test.mjs && node test/light.test.mjs && node test/forecast.test.mjs
